message: non-recursive function V_fn is called through call_fn at V_where: compiled mode must inline it
why: Hermes is a compiled language: non-recursive functions are expanded at compile time so the runtime has no dynamic dispatch. A call_fn to a non-recursive function means the IR came from an older compiler, was hand-edited, or codegen has a bug. Allowing it would silently reintroduce dynamic dispatch exactly where the bounds are supposed to be static.
fix: rebuild the IR with the current compiler (non-recursive calls are inlined)
if V_fn really recurses, mark it recursive — the depth limit 512 is the only runtime guard
